property_summary: For every input where contract_address is address(0), the reference C.transfer always reverts (due to validAddress) while the mutant may NOT revert and may return true when the low-level calls to the callee succeed; thus there exists inputs (tos/vs with a deployed helper that accepts calls) where the reference reverts but the mutant returns true.
change_summary: Relax the validAddress modifier to allow address(0x0) (remove that require), so calls with zero address pass validation and may change return behavior when contract_address is zero.
